The '''CR-43XA''' was a street-legal version of [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]]'s [[CR-43 Low-Ride Gossbey Racing Edition]]. It had a flight ceiling of fifty-five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and a top speed of 800 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="BSS" />
